description: Installation of a kitchen extraction/ventilation system to rear
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: normal;">Covering Letter dated 25/02/2025;&nbsp;Kitchen Extraction &amp; Odour Control System Proposal;&nbsp;Design and Access Statement dated February 2025;&nbsp;</span><span style="line-height: normal;">OSMap; </span><span style="line-height: normal;">Block Plan;&nbsp;</span><span style="line-height: normal;">Existing &amp; Proposed Ground Floor Plan;&nbsp;</span><span style="line-height: normal;">Existing &amp; Proposed Roof Plan;&nbsp;</span><span style="line-height: normal;">Existing &amp; Proposed Front Elevation;&nbsp;</span><span style="line-height: normal;">Existing &amp; Proposed Rear Elevation;&nbsp;</span><span style="line-height: normal;">Existing &amp; Proposed Left Side Elevation;&nbsp;Existing &amp; Proposed Left Side Elevation; Noise Impact Assessment Issue 01, dated 21/02/2025.</span>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="line-height:normal">The proposed Kitchen Extraction/Ventilation System shall be installed, used and operated in accordance with all the specifications, components prescribed in the approved Noise Impact Assessment Issue 01, dated 21/02/2025 and the approved Kitchen Extraction &amp; Odour Control System Proposal. It shall be maintained in good and effective order thereafter so as not to cause any noise, vibration and /or, odour/fume nuisance to any nearby occupied neighbouring properties.</span></span></p>
